data_kind: self-chosen pedagogical inputs; not 145Tb/193Bi or any experiment

gate.label: g
gate.coefficient_kind: chosen normalized single-gamma W coefficients, not nuclear alpha or maximum reference

counts.primitive_model: independent Poisson gross_S/gross_L/shared_sideband; sideband is the same estimator used in both net peaks; fixed scale factors

calibration.model: Gaussian log-efficiency latent errors; common normalization plus common group geometry plus energy-specific residual; input central efficiencies are medians

independent_intrinsic_ratio.identity: self-chosen independent single-gamma intrinsic S/L reference; no shared events or calibration
independent_intrinsic_ratio.use: optional independent check f_emp=R/r0; never constructed from the same R

response_assumptions: uniform detector efficiencies within each group
point nominal angles, no azimuth/pair losses except self-exclusion
separable omega1*omega2 only, not a full quantum gamma-gamma response
same source intensity normalization for the two target groups
background scales chosen fixed; real fitted scales may also have covariance
